Remark
[Combined Duhamel formula] ↗ thm:heat-equation-initial-value-solution ↗ thm:heat-equation-nonhomogeneous-solution 1. ch2:2.3.1-rem-2\group Heat Equation

Under the preceding hypotheses, \[ (17)\qquad u(x,t)=\int _{\R ^n}\Phi (x-y,t)g(y)\, dy +\int _0^t\int _{\R ^n}\Phi (x-y,t-s)f(y,s)\, dy\, ds \] solves $u_t-\Delta u=f$ with $u(\cdot ,0)=g$.
